settings.transcripts.heading: Iḍrisen
settings.transcripts.info: Iɣewwaṛen n yiḍrisen ttwalin amek d anida ttwaḥerzen tezmilin-ik, tasarut API n yisefka YouTube ara nesseqdec (tilaq i yibuddar d tebdarin n turart), d iɣewwaṛen ifrayanen n usuqqel.
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.name: Akaram aẓar n yiḍrisen
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc: Akaram aẓar anda ara ttwaseggmen ikaramen i d-izeddin n yiḍrisen (am inbox, notes atg.)
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.name: Tasarut API n yisefka YouTube
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc: Tasarut-ik API n Google cloud console i unekcum ɣer yiḍrisen izuyaz n YouTube (mačči d ajiṭun OAUTH). Tilaq i usader n yibuddar d tebdarin n turart.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe: Tasarut tafrayant i umeẓlu n yiḍrisen scrapecreators. Ticki tettusbadu, tettuseqdac d tarrayt tagejdant. Awi tasarut baṭel deg app.scrapecreators.com (100 n yisutar baṭel). Tettwawelleh i yiḍrisen iṣeḥḥan; asekcem usrid seg YouTube yerreẓ ticki YouTube ibeddel amek i d-yettak iḍrisen n ddaw.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.name: Tasarut API n Supa data
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc: Tasarut tafrayant i umeẓlu n yiḍrisen supadata. Ticki tettusbadu, tettuseqdac d tarrayt tagejdant (ma ulac tasarut scrapecreators). Awi tasarut deg supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d: Tangalt n tutlayt tasaḍest i usuqqel (am en, es, fr, de). Seqdec «en» akken ad yeqqim ugbur s teglizit.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de: Tangalt n tmurt neɣ n temnaḍt tasaḍest i usuqqel (am us, gb, ca). Tettuseqdac i lqem n tutlayt s temnaḍt.
settings.llm.heading: Tamudelt n tutlayt
settings.llm.info: Fren amefki AI, sekcem tasarut-is API, syen fren tamudelt. Tazɣelt tseddu tasnulfut; amḍan afellay n ijitunen isewḥel teɣzi n tuffɣa. Yettwawelleh OpenRouter ɣef twuridt-is; gemini-2.5-flash n Google d arxis, maca iswiren-is irxisen zemren ad ttwaḥebsen.
settings.llm.provider.name: Amefki
settings.llm.provider.desc: Amefki ara yesseqdec i ugzul. Yettwawelleh OpenRouter ɣef twuridt-is; iswiren irxisen n Gemini zemren ad ttwaḥebsen.
settings.llm.apiKey.name: Tasarut API n {provider}
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud: Yettwaḥrez deg uḥraz uffir n Obsidian, mačči deg yisefka n usiɣzef.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama: URL n uqeddac, yettwaḥrez deg yisefka n usiɣzef.
settings.llm.model.name: Tamudelt n {provider}
settings.llm.model.desc: Fren tamudelt tuheggit neɣ aru isem n tmudelt tudmawant ddaw-a.
settings.llm.modelParams.heading: Iɣewwaṛen n tmudelt ({provider})
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom: Ilaq: tamudelt-a ulac-itt deg ukaram — sbadu asfaylu n umnaḍ, tuffɣa tafellayt, d amḍan n uḥraz akken ad yili usmizeḍ n yijitunen s laman.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride: Ha-t-an ilisa n yijitunen n tmudelt-a, ččuren-d seg yisefka yettwassnen. Ẓreg urti akken ad t-tesnifleḍ i umefki d tmudelt-a.
settings.llm.contextWindow.name: Asfaylu n umnaḍ (k ijitunen)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc: Asfaylu n umnaḍ ummid s walfat n yijitunen (am 400 i 400k n yijitunen)
settings.llm.maxOutput.name: Tuffɣa tafellayt (k ijitunen)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc: Ijitunen n tuffɣa ufellay s walfat (am 128 i 128k n yijitunen)
settings.llm.inputMax.name: Anekcum afellay (k ijitunen) - afrayan
settings.llm.inputMax.desc: Talast tuzrirt n unekcum ma yella amefki yessufeɣ-itt (eǧǧ d ilem i usiḍen awurman)
settings.llm.reservePct.name: Amḍan n uḥraz
settings.llm.reservePct.desc: Aḥraz n tɣellist i yijitunen n tuffɣa (0.10 = 10%, amezwer: {default})
settings.llm.temperature.name: Tazɣelt
settings.llm.temperature.desc: Yesseddu tarurbant n tuffɣa (0-1). Azal amejṭuḥ yettuẓẓig ugar, azal ameqqran yesnulfuy ugar. Azal amiran: {value}

settings.prompts.extensive.heading: Isuturen n ugzul usliɣ

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc: Iwellihen i tikli n llms ticki d-snulfuyen igzulen iruraden
settings.prompts.userFast.name: Asuter n useqdac (agzul arurad)
settings.prompts.userFast.desc: Iwellihen ussiden i ugzul n uḍris s zzerb d tewzel
settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder: Ttxil-k gzel aḍris YouTube i d-iteddun...
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.name: Asuter n unagraw (agzul usliɣ)
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc: Iwellihen i tikli n llms ticki d-snulfuyen igzulen leqqayen d yemmden
settings.prompts.userExtensive.name: Asuter n useqdac (agzul usliɣ)
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc: Iwellihen ussiden i tmerna n tzemmilin leqqayen d yesɣiwsen seg uḍris
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold: Seg uḍris ddaw-a, snulfu-d tizemmilin leqqayen d yesɣiwsen...
settings.prompts.defaultMode.name: Askar amezwer n ugzul
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc: Fren askar amezwer n ugzul ticki ibeddu usiɣzef. Askar arurad yettaǧǧa iseɣwan n tirect n wakud akken ad yezreb usesfer.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.name: Rnu iseɣwan n tirect n wakud YouTube
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc: Rnu i yal azwel n tigzi yettwaṭṭfen s umḍan aseɣwen ara yawin ɣer tirect n wakud yemṣadan deg tvidyut YouTube (tamawt: yensa deg uskar n ugzul arurad)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool: Ticki yermed, yesnaqas ijitunen n tikkelt tamezwarut s 12% akken ad yeǧǧ amkan i yiseɣwan. Yettensay s wudem awurman deg uskar n ugzul arurad.
settings.advanced.heading: Talqayt
settings.advanced.info: Iɣewwaṛen leqqayen i useɣti n tuccḍiwin. Rmed aɣmis n useɣti akken ad ternuḍ talɣut leqqayen i yal tazmilt i tallalt tatiknikt.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.name: Rmed aɣmis n useɣti
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc: Rmed iɣmisen leqqayen n useɣti. Ticki yermed, talɣut n useɣti ad tettwarnu i yal tazmilt d tanaḍt tuffirt i useɣti n wuguren.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt: Ticki yermed, talɣut n useɣti ad d-tettwajmeɛ ad ternu ɣer tzemmilin d tanaḍt tuffirt, deg umkan n uɣmis ɣer tdiwennit.
